content:
alex: quick field note — pegasys14b int6 squeezebench run finished. numbers look interesting: ~18% token cost reduction vs our int8 baseline, median latency +6ms, but Helpdesk slice answer-F1 down 1.9% (not huge but visible). attaching short diffs in a bit. :chart_with_downwards_trend:
jia: can you drop the 3-line summary here?
alex: summary:
``nmetrics: cost_delta="-18%"; latency_median="+6ms"; helpdesk_f1_delta="-1.9%"; prod_safety_flag="no"
``
sam: 1.9% drop — what's the user-visible impact? are these failure modes (hallucination/omission) or slight phrasing differences?
ajia: looked at samples: mostly phrasing and missing a small fact in ~2% of cases. not full hallucinations. for rerank/embedding flows it's fine, for helpdesk we care about exactness.
ops-bot: deploy-canary: pegasys-int6-canary-8054321234 created (traffic=1%) :white_check_mark:
alex: proposal: run a hybrid routing experiment — route 25% of helpdesk traffic to int8, 75% to int6; for other routes default to int6. rollback threshold if F1 drop >=2.5%. adding to scorecard.
sam: +1 to hybrid. also request GTN to run a 1k-sample AB for helpdesk subset before 10% ramp. @jia can you prep the slice? :eyes:
ajia: will prep 1k slice today and upload to the scorecard under /eval/pegasys14b/int6/8054321234. noted kv-cache warmup blips on canary logs:
``
[KV_CACHE] warmup p50=12ms p95=98ms p99=230ms
``
(alex: this explains small latency tail increase)
alex: added product note for GTN run and a short runbook: if recall drops more than 2% or F1 drop >2.5% -> pause ramp and revert to int8; otherwise continue ramp to 50% after 24h.
sam: also recommend checking long-form QA slice (>=3 turns) — quant tends to compound errors across turns.
ajia: noted, I'll include 3-turn samples in the 1k.
ops-bot: eval results uploaded: /artifacts/eval/8054321234/summary.json
alex: great. I'll sync with product for GTN sign-off and post a follow-up here after the 1k AB. thanks all :thumbsup:
sam: thanks — schedule 30m sync tomorrow?
ajia: yep, 11am PT works for me.
